messages:
Maria T: Quick sync — planning to roll out the `pii_logging_v2` feature flag tomorrow morning. Need clarity on canary audience, retention guardrails, and KMS/HSM path. Assigning owners.

Samir R: TL;DR — what's the minimal canary scope? do we keep write path disabled and only audit logs first? :thinking:

Alex P: Minimal canary = 5% internal traffic + security/internal-beta cohort. Agree on audit-only first.

Jen K: Also need rollback plan & metrics to watch. Which counters/alerts should trigger auto-rollback?

Maria T: Proposed metrics: error rate > 1% for the canary, latency p99 increase > 200ms, spike in token volume > 20%.

Samir R: OK. For retention, suggest 30 days for raw PII logs, 90 days for derived/hashed metadata. We should document KMS path and HSM usage.

Alex P: HSM/KMS details — use customer-managed key path for private tenants, otherwise fallback to platform KMS. Example key: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/pii-key`.

Maria T: Config snippet below (audit-only default):
```
flag: pii_logging_v2
enabled: off
canary:
  percent: 5
  audiences: ["internal-beta","security-team"]
guardrails:
  retention_days_raw: 30
  retention_days_meta: 90
  kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/rlk/cryptoKeys/pii-key
  hsm_required_for_tenant: true
  audit_mode: true
```

Jen K: Should `audit_mode: true` mean writes go to staging-only bucket and never to customer buckets? We need that spelled out in the runbook.

Maria T: Yes — audit_mode => writes to `s3://redwood-pii-audit-staging/<env>/` only. No customer data leaves staging until we flip flag to enabled.

Samir R: Who owns the runbook update? I'll take it if Maria ok.

Maria T: please do, thx. Add the rollback commands and the alert playbook.

Alex P: Rollback command (CLI):
```
rctl flag set pii_logging_v2 --off
rctl deploy rollback --release pii_logging_v2-canary
```
Also put these on the canary run page: https://go.redwood.internal/canary-runbook/pii-logging

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment created for `pii_logging_v2` at 2025-08-17T09:00:00Z — canary=5% (internal-beta, security-team)

sec-bot: Audit entry: rollout-intent recorded by Maria T; review checklist assigned to Samir R, Alex P, Jen K. Link: https://go.redwood.internal/sec/audit/entries/9812

Jen K: Quick check — monitoring dashboards? Add p99 latency, errors, token-volume, and a synthetic that hits downstream KMS.

Maria T: Will add dashboards and attach links in runbook by EOD.

Samir R: One more: test key rotation path with HSM before enabling for any private tenant. I'll run rotation test tomorrow.

Alex P: FYI — for private tenants we require HSM binding; code path is guarded by `use_hsm && hsm_required_for_tenant`.

Maria T: OK team — final checklist: runbook updated, dashboards created, KMS/HSM test done, deploy warnings on, canary scheduled. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:

Jen K: pinged on PR with alerts and dashboards. cc @Samir R for HSM test.

Samir R: KMS rotation test passed on staging. No regressions. :white_check_mark:

Maria T: Thanks — proceeding with canary at the scheduled time, will update thread with outcome.
